components.evidence: lodash.js is lodash's own UMD build (define.amd); it inlines no other package. Its banner says "Based on Underscore.js 1.8.3 <http://underscorejs.org/LICENSE>" (lodash.js line 6, with "Copyright Jeremy Ashkenas, DocumentCloud and Investigative Reporters & Editors"; lodash.min.js line 3 names the same), so Underscore's LICENSE at tag 1.8.3 is given. lodash's own LICENSE (in its package) also credits Underscore. || For lodash.min.js: lodash.min.js is lodash's own UMD build (define.amd); it inlines no other package. Its banner says "Based on Underscore.js 1.8.3 <http://underscorejs.org/LICENSE>" (lodash.js line 6, with "Copyright Jeremy Ashkenas, DocumentCloud and Investigative Reporters & Editors"; lodash.min.js line 3 names the same), so Underscore's LICENSE at tag 1.8.3 is given. lodash's own LICENSE (in its package) also credits Underscore.
